prompt:
Add four independent text utility modules to the more_itertools package. They share no code and no symbols; each lives in its own new file.

1. more_itertools/spd_slug.py: slugify(text) lowercases, replaces every run of non-alphanumeric ASCII characters with a single hyphen, and strips leading and trailing hyphens. slugify('') is ''.
2. more_itertools/spd_rle.py: encode(s) run-length encodes a string as count followed by the character (aaab -> 3a1b); decode(s) reverses it. Characters are never digits. encode('') and decode('') are ''. decode raises ValueError on a trailing count with no character.
3. more_itertools/spd_roman.py: to_roman(n) for 1..3999 returns the standard subtractive roman numeral, ValueError outside the range; from_roman(s) is the inverse, accepts upper case only, ValueError on anything that is not the canonical form of some number.
4. more_itertools/spd_wordfreq.py: word_freq(text, top=None) counts case-insensitive words (maximal runs of ASCII letters and apostrophes) and returns a list of (word, count) sorted by count descending then word ascending; with top=N only the first N entries.

All functions are plain Python with no third-party dependencies. Do not modify existing modules or tests.
Commit your work on a new branch and push it.
